prompt: I have an iPhone and I'm tired of charging my watch every night. What watch can I wear for weeks without charging?

turns.prompt: I have an iPhone and I'm tired of charging my watch every night. What watch can I wear for weeks without charging?
turns.answer:
Absolutely. Since you're using an iPhone, I'd look at Garmin, COROS, and Amazfit rather than another Apple Watch.

There are several watches that can last 2–5 weeks on a single charge, and some solar-powered models can last virtually indefinitely under ideal sunlight conditions.
